title: INSTA KILL AUTO ATTACK AUTO COLLECT CHEST ESP OP
features:
Once executed, you can kill anyone in the game by just walking up to them, which steals their crops and chests they've collected, all barriers are removed so that you can even go up to people that are way ahead of you in the game and take their stuff. Auto Chops crops for you, gives you chest ESP aswell as collects any chests automatically for you.

FEATURES:
• INSTA Kill
• Auto Attack / Chop
• ESP
• Auto Collect Chests
• Speed

Works with ALL executors
script:
getgenv().Settings = {
	autoAttackInstaKill = true,
	playerESP = true,
	chestESP = true,
	autoCollectChests = true,
    speedboost = 23,
    jumpboost = 10,
}

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raxscripts/LuaUscripts/refs/heads/main/ChopCrop.lua"))()
